steps.say: Some endings sound the same but are spelt differently. Learn the patterns.
-cial usually follows a vowel, and -tial usually follows a consonant.
Adjectives ending in -ent make nouns ending in -ence. Those ending in -ant make nouns ending in -ance.
If a verb is stressed on its last syllable, double the final consonant before -ed or -ing.
Homonyms are spelt the same but have different meanings. Use the rest of the sentence to choose the meaning.
steps.show: the bank of a river     money in the bank

check.prompt: Add -ing to begin. Write the new word.
hints: Say be-GIN. Which syllable is stressed?
The stress is on the last syllable, which ends in one vowel and one consonant.
Double the final consonant, then add -ing.
check.explanation: Begin is stressed at the end, so the n doubles: beginning.
